prompt_content.content:
ユニークで興味深いフィクションのキャラクターを、詳細な性格と共に生成してください。
性別は「male」、年齢は「60」歳です。
Invent a character who is a retired soldier turned peaceful farmer.

personalities.description: Henry embodies a stoic attitude, shaped by years of military service. He approaches life with a calm demeanor, rarely showing extreme emotion, and believes in enduring hardship with resilience.

Despite his tough exterior, Henry has a deeply nurturing side, especially towards his crops and animals. He derives immense joy from tending to his farm, treating each plant and creature as an essential part of his life.

Henry spends considerable time reflecting on his past experiences, both in the military and in civilian life. This reflective nature enables him to share important life lessons with younger generations, helping them navigate their own challenges.

character_request.additional_instructions: Invent a character who is a retired soldier turned peaceful farmer.
